breed: The Twelve Cats of Christmas, Part One
positioning: Seven days. Twenty-eight cats. One pear tree.
story: Every carol has a list. This one has cats.

The old song counts twelve days of gifts. Ours counts twelve days of cats, starting today, Sunday, December 20. A Maine Coon sits in the pear tree. Every day after that, a bigger group joins her in the same snowy courtyard.
Two Siamese talk. Three Manx mewing. Four Folds creep. Five Sphynx sprint. Six Bengals bound. Seven Korats kick. By Saturday the courtyard holds 28 cats.
The tune is old. It first appeared in print in England in 1780, in a children’s book. The pear tree stayed. The partridge, we decided, was a Maine Coon.
Keep the cookies up high and the tinsel off the floor. A cat’s idea of a present is the box.
Turn the page. The Maine Coon is waiting, and she has no plan for getting down.
rank_cap: cats in the courtyard by Saturday
fblocks: The Twelve Days of Christmas appeared in England in 1780. It was a children’s rhyme, not a hymn.
Maine Coon, America’s largest native breed. Siamese, the one with opinions. Sphynx, the one who wants the fire.
Lilies, tinsel and ribbon are dangerous for cats. Even a little lily pollen can harm the kidneys. Keep all of it out of reach.
Most cats dislike clothes. If you try, keep it loose and short and never leave it on unwatched.
28 cats by Saturday. 78 by New Year’s Eve. 12 days. 1 pear tree.
days: One Maine Coon, one pear tree, and no plan for getting down.
Siamese come from Thailand, once called Siam, and they talk more than most breeds. Two of them have opinions about the pear tree.
Manx cats come from the Isle of Man and are born with little or no tail, from a natural gene. Three Manx mewing at the gate until someone opens it.
Scottish Fold kittens are born with straight ears. Four Folds creep toward the cookies with them folded flat.
Sphynx cats have almost no coat, so they love a warm spot. Five sprint across the snow toward the fire. Wisdom is knowing where the heat is.
The Bengal began with a cross between a domestic cat and the Asian leopard cat. On Christmas Day, six Bengals bound across the courtyard.
In Thailand the Korat is a cat of good luck, and one is traditionally given as a gift. Seven Korats kick up the snow for luck.
last_walk:
The snow keeps falling on the courtyard.
Twenty-eight cats are settling in for the night. The Maine Coon still holds her branch. The Korats slept where they stopped. Stay a minute by the lights. Eight Ragdolls are on their way.
